annotations.title: Benchmark an x402 seller against the whole catalog

description: For x402 sellers and builders: rank of each listing by 30-day payers, percentile in its category, price vs the category paid median, metadata gaps (input schema, output example, tags, name, description) compared with the top decile, nearest competitors, a live probe and concrete recommendations. origin = host or one paid endpoint URL. Unknown seller = error, not charged. PAID: $0.05 per call, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a Route Pass (header Authorization: Bearer ap1...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/seller.

origin.description: Seller host (api.example.com) or a full https URL of one of its paid endpoints. Default: the most-paid origin in the catalog (example)
